payload.next: If the error recurs, capture only the failing API path, HTTP status, and timestamp on that exact attempt. Keep broader project parity and sign-out acceptance open.
payload.summary: A fresh Chrome sign-in from OpenCut local Production 3211 reached Legitate over HTTPS. User completed consent and MFA, confirmed success, and the browser returned to the authenticated OpenCut projects page with New project visible. Anonymous entry and both exact OIDC callback registrations were checked on ports 3000 and 3211. No source, settings, release, or server changes were needed for this retry. The earlier transient error was not reproduced and its cause is unresolved.
